prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production asset for a 2D cute woodland game. Create a perfectly aligned 3 by 3 atlas of NINE SQUARE GROUND TEXTURES, square image 1536x1536 desired. Each cell fills its square edge to edge, with no gaps, no gutters, no border, no labels. Straight flat orthographic top-down, NO perspective. These are WALKABLE GROUND ONLY, NO trees, NO bushes, NO buildings, NO ponds, NO large rocks, NO paths and NO horizon. Soft hand-painted cartoon texture to match supplied approved map previews. No text, no UI, no characters.
